tagline: Keep the moments. Clear the clutter.
summary: Find similar photos on your iPhone, choose what to keep and clear the rest. Or delete photos within a date range, including favorites, after confirming.
availability: For iPhone · iOS 17 or later · Coming soon · Free, no ads or in-app purchases
howTitle: A little space for your memories.
step1: Organize the last 7 days, this month or custom dates. Both end dates are included, using the photo creation date and your device's calendar and time zone. Limited access means only authorized photos are included.
step2: Similar photos and system bursts are grouped on your device. Each group starts with suggested keepers; keep more or choose another. Similar cleanup protects favorites and always keeps at least one photo per group. Recommendations are not an aesthetic score.
step3: Clean one group or all unkept photos, then confirm with iOS. Canceling leaves photos unchanged. Only successful deletions appear in your local history.
dateTitle: Certain you no longer need them? Clean by date.
dateBody: The separate Date Cleanup tab offers the last 7 days, last 30 days or custom dates. Preview the photos and counts, then confirm in the app and with iOS. This deletes every deletable photo in the range, including favorites, Live Photos and hidden photos accessible to the app. It does not keep a photo automatically or use the similar-cleanup ignored list. Videos are excluded. Photos the system cannot delete are counted and preserved.
safetyBody: Date cleanup never adds new photos to a confirmed selection. Changing dates, changing the library or leaving the app invalidates the preview. Review it again before deleting. If iCloud Photos is enabled, deletion syncs to other devices using the same library.
recoveryBody: Open Apple's Photos app and Recently Deleted to recover a photo, normally within 30 days. SnapTrim never empties Recently Deleted permanently and does not keep a photo backup. iOS and iCloud manage available space; deleting does not guarantee an immediate increase in free storage.
limitsBody: Each operation supports up to 5,000 photos. Similarity compares images taken within 10 minutes; system bursts use their burst identifier. Dense libraries may require a smaller date range. Recognition is an aid and may miss duplicates. Live Photo recognition uses the still image; deletion removes the whole asset. Cloud downloads are off by default. Enabling them uses Apple's Photos service and may consume data and temporary storage. Scanning stops in the background; cached results help when you restart.
languageBody: SnapTrim follows the device's supported language by default, with English as fallback. In Settings, choose one of 14 languages or return to Follow System. Your choice is stored locally. App text updates immediately; iOS permission and deletion dialogs may follow the system's app-language setting. Language switching is unavailable while scanning, loading or deleting.
contactBody: Email your iPhone model, iOS version, app version and the steps that led to the issue. Do not send private photos. Developer: Peng Lin.
privacyIntro: Effective October 9, 2026. SnapTrim: Photo Cleaner is developed by Peng Lin. Version 1.0 has no accounts, advertising, purchases, analytics or tracking SDKs.
privacyDevice: Photos, creation dates, dimensions, favorites and burst identifiers are read only within the access you grant. Similarity uses Apple Vision or an on-device perceptual fingerprint. The developer does not receive, store or sell your photos, image features or photo-library metadata.
privacyStorage: Recognition caches, photo identifiers, review choices, ignored items, language preference and operation dates/counts are stored locally. Recognition caches and review state are excluded from system backup. You can clear caches, reset ignored items and clear history in the app. Uninstalling removes app-local data but does not restore deleted photos.
privacyPermissions: You can revoke or limit Photos access in iOS Settings. Cloud image downloads are optional and handled by Apple's Photos service under Apple's privacy policy. Similar cleanup protects favorites; Date Cleanup includes favorites and requires app and system confirmation. Deletion may sync through iCloud and normally remains recoverable in Recently Deleted for 30 days.
privacyWebsite: Opening marketing, help or privacy links connects your browser to GitHub Pages, which may process IP addresses and request logs. This website stores only a language preference locally and has no analytics or advertising scripts. If you email support, we receive your email address and message solely to answer your request. Please do not attach private photos.
privacyFuture: Future advertising or purchase features will require updated product information and privacy disclosures before release. Contact 540933120@qq.com for privacy questions.
subtitle: Similar & date photo cleanup
promotion: Find similar photos on your iPhone. Keep the ones you love, or clean a date range with clear confirmation. Your photos stay on your device.
screensNote: Actual app screens using disposable sample photos, not a user's personal library.
